readingProgressBar.implementation: JS scroll event, width as % of page scrolled

links.fontFamily: Source Sans Pro, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

characterDescription: A minimal editorial masthead: warm paper background at 95% opacity, bottom border a breath of ink. Logo in Playfair Display. Navigation links in Source Sans Pro — lowercase, weight 400, no uppercase formality. The reading progress bar runs along the bottom edge of the nav, wine red filling left-to-right as the reader descends. The nav is the magazine's header line — structural, not decorative.
